hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *package-lock.json) echo 'Blocked: package-lock.json must only change via npm commands, not direct edits.' >&2; exit 2;; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */web/src/*.ts|*/web/src/*.tsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web" && npx tsc --noEmit 1>&2 || exit 2;; esac
